skills.description: This skill should be used when an AI Agent (WorkBuddy, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, etc.) needs to read Office files (.xlsx/.xls/.doc/.docx/.ppt/.pptx/.mdb/.accdb), PDF files (.pdf), or other documents that are protected by transparent-encryption DLP software (ESAFENET/亿赛通, TianRui LvDun/天锐绿盾, IP-Guard, DSE) and the Agent built-in Read/Write tools only return ciphertext. It provides a Node.js MCP Server pattern that reads encrypted files as plaintext by delegating to whitelisted Office COM apps via PowerShell (Excel/Word/PowerPoint/Access), with PDF support via Word COM's built-in PDF converter (Office 2013+). Includes a headless-safe Word path (first-run seeding + timeout guard + Open XML fallback for unencrypted .docx) and a diagnosis procedure to find which processes are on the encryption software trust whitelist.
